* What is dropshipping?
Dropshipping is the method of shipping products straight to your customers coming from a third-party distributor or supplier, without having an intermediary step (like storing the products at your physical business location).
Dropshipping is the act of selling a product on your website without actually handling the order fulfillment and delivery. Another advantage of dropshipping is that you will not pay for the goods until the customer pays for them, making dropshipping an appealing option for people who don't want to risk buying products that won't easily sell. Step 2 - The customer purchases something from your eCommerce store.
